Practice 05

A structure holds its value when it is measured, recorded and corrected with data from day one.

In short

HAYKALAH’s digital practice builds the reporting, records and systems that keep a structured asset or company on plan: AI reporting dashboards, ERP and CRM automation, and investment-platform architecture. We deliver it in-house and with partners, including Cyber HAYKALAH, our cybersecurity venture. The practice serves owners, boards, investors and operators who need one source of truth.

What we do

  • AI reporting dashboards with live KPIs for investors, boards and operators.

  • ERP, CRM and workflow automation that removes manual steps and lowers the cost to serve.

  • Asset-performance monitoring with sensor data on occupancy, energy and maintenance.

  • Data rooms and digital records with a full audit trail, ready for investors and for tokenization.

  • Investment-platform architecture for funds, Sukuk and tokenized offerings.

  • HOAM opportunity scoring for deal screening.

  • Data protection by design under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

How we create value

  • 01

    Innovation

    We design new digital tools for structured assets, such as investment-platform architecture and HOAM opportunity scoring, built in-house and with partners including Cyber HAYKALAH.

  • 04

    Automation

    We automate reporting and routine work with AI dashboards that show live KPIs, and with ERP, CRM and workflow automation that removes manual steps.

  • 05

    Transformation

    We change how an asset or company is run: KPIs go live on day one, digital records keep one source of truth, and variance alerts trigger action early.

How we work

  1. 01

    Optimize

    Design the asset and its processes before capital is committed.

  2. 02

    Measure

    KPIs, dashboards and sensors go live on day one.

  3. 03

Questions

What does an AI reporting dashboard show?

It brings the KPIs of an asset or company into one live view, such as occupancy, revenue, cost and variance against plan, and flags where results move away from the model.

What is asset tokenization?

Tokenization records ownership rights in an asset as digital tokens. Where the tokens are securities, issuing and dealing in them are regulated activities, executed through appropriately licensed partners.

What is a data room?

A secure, organized store of the documents that investors and lenders review. It keeps one version of every document, so the model and the files agree.

How is personal data protected?

HAYKALAH designs systems to comply with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) from the start.

Does HAYKALAH build the technology itself?

HAYKALAH builds in-house and with partners, including Cyber HAYKALAH, a HAYKALAH cybersecurity venture.

Tell us what you need to measure. We can start under an NDA.
